text:
Maya: FYI — saw a concentrated preempt in eu-west-1 this morning: ~40% of GPU spot nodes went away inside 12m. Batch p99 shot up, some realtime requests hit fallbacks. Noticed CA created new spot nodes but they arrived too late. We need a robust plan that keeps cost but avoids these tail failures. Ideas?

Jon: ouch. can we gate critical pods to reserved/dedicated pool? mixed-capacity makes sense: tiny committed pool + spot for overflow. also try 'prefer-newer' scale-down + zone spread.

Samir: agree on a small committed reserve. also propose a pre-drain lifecycle hook + proactive eviction-proxy: when termination notice appears, mark node with taint and re-schedule hotspot pods before drain finishes. That buys ~30s to move stuff.

Lina: CA tuning is key too — it waited for metric thresholds. tweak scale-up-cooldown and expander strategy. and we should prioritize pods with high QPS into dedicated class via nodeAffinity + priorityClass.

infra-bot: [spot-watcher] TerminationNotice: i-0abc1234 eu-west-1a preempt at 2026-03-18T09:02:12Z (2m warning)

Maya: hmm we need automated path for the 2m window — ideas for in-cluster fast evict + local caching so inference doesn't cold-start heavy models?

Samir: pattern I've used: lifecycle webhook listens for termination, adds taint node.kubernetes.io/preempting:NoSchedule, creates a short-lived annotation with provision hint, then patch protected pods to prefer warm nodes. snippet:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: model-aggregator
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "dedicated-reserve"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  priorityClassName: "high-priority-inference"
```
Then a small sidecar copies hot KV cache to EU local disk to speed startup on next node.

Jon: also add a CA webhook that prefers allocating to zones with >50% spare capacity. We can use node-template hints to prefer gpustandard vs gput2 for fallback. cheaper but slower.

Lina: don't forget PDBs — some controller pods should be allowed to be evicted (no PDB) while frontend inference routers should have PDB to avoid simultaneous eviction. mix PDB + priority to force safe shrink.

Maya: cost tradeoffs? small committed pool increases baseline cost. what's our ballpark?

Samir: example: for one realtime shard, keeping 2 dedicated gpus in region reduces spot tail by ~80%. cost delta ~ +15% compared to all-spot, but latency SLO is preserved. we should A/B with canary traffic.

Jon: rollout plan idea: 1) create a new node-group 'reserve-gpu-small' (2 nodes) in each region; 2) apply priorityClass + nodeAffinity for critical pods; 3) enable termination webhook + pre-drain taint; 4) tune CA scale-up window to 30s and aggressive expander; 5) run 48h soak.

Maya: can someone draft the preStop hook + taint flow? Also need runbook updates (how to manually failover if CA misbehaves).

Samir: here's a minimal preStop lifecycle handler we used:```bash
# lifecycle-hook handler (pseudo)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/evict -d '{"node":"$NODE_NAME"}'
kubectl taint nodes $NODE_NAME preempting=true:NoSchedule --overwrite
# mark for fast kube-scheduler reschedule of tolerant pods
```

Lina: CA flags to try: --scale-up-delay=10s --max-node-provision-time=5m --expander=least-waste. also reduce--scan-interval to 5s for faster reaction (watch CPU/alloc). test in staging first.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Created nodegroup reserve-gpu-small in eu-west-1 (2x a1-gpu).

Maya: nice. also we need metrics: track node-preempt events, time-to-new-node and request-fallback-rate. propose alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% for 15m.

Samir: agree. add per-route SLO burn rate to console dashboards. worth adding a canary that intentionally uses spot-only pool to validate behavior.

Jon: final note — storage: ensure ephemeral model cache uses emptyDir with a warm-copy from dedicated pool before pod schedules. that cuts coldstart from ~55s to <10s.

Maya: OK actionable list looks good. I'll own runbook + canary. Samir do pre-drain hook PR, Lina tune CA flags in staging. Jon will wire dashboard. Ping me when PRs exist and we schedule the 48h soak. :thumbsup:

Lina: will create CA tweak PR and add tests.

Samir: starting pre-drain webhook PR now.
